audit_metadata.task: Task 1.3J - CHRONOS-X Local Temporal Capability & Safe Fallback Audit
audit_metadata.audit_verdict: LIMITED TEMPORAL CAPABILITY — SAFE FALLBACK VERIFIED

genuinely_implemented: Quality flag filtering and binary mask dilation (FATAL_FLAG_MASK = 615)
Dipole artifact rejection via 5x5 stamp min/max ratio test
missing_or_deficient: Minimum temporal baseline gating (inspect_fits uses min_time_diff_days=0.001 which accepts 1.44 min dithers)
Detector and spectral channel compatibility checks (allows differencing across dissimilar detectors)
Cross-release calibration veto (flags inter-release in CSV but differencing engine does not enforce veto)
Orthogonal temporal eligibility schema representation (CandidateRecord lacks dedicated temporal status fields)
Automated fallback trigger in candidate ranking (FusionEngine classifies dither anomalies as NEW_TRANSIENT_OR_ASTEROID_CANDIDATE)

critical_risk_points.issue: min_time_diff_days = 0.001 treats intra-visit dithers (t ~ 2-6 min) as temporal pairs.
critical_risk_points.risk: Fills candidate manifest with astrometric registration tests rather than secular variability pairs.

critical_risk_points.issue: Feeds dither 1D1 vs 4D1 into differencer and populates chronos_score.
critical_risk_points.risk: Passes intra-visit dither significance directly to multimodal fusion.

critical_risk_points.issue: Assigns NEW_TRANSIENT_OR_ASTEROID_CANDIDATE if chronos_score > 5.0 and no Gaia star, without checking dt baseline.
critical_risk_points.risk: Fabricates transient discovery from registration residuals or intra-visit noise.

critical_risk_points.issue: Generates synthetic exponential random scores for temporal significance without explicit synthetic flag.
critical_risk_points.risk: Simulated values could be mistaken for genuine SPHEREx detections if run in production demo.

recommended_temporal_specific_labels.label: TEMPORAL_VALIDATED
recommended_temporal_specific_labels.definition: Pair meets E4 criteria AND delta_t >= 1 day between independent epochs with compatible detectors.

recommended_temporal_specific_labels.label: TEMPORAL_NOT_ELIGIBLE
recommended_temporal_specific_labels.definition: Pair contains intra-visit dithers (delta_t < 1 day) or mismatched detectors; safe for registration demo only.

recommended_temporal_specific_labels.label: TEMPORAL_UNVERIFIABLE
recommended_temporal_specific_labels.definition: Pair lacks authoritative MJD timestamps, valid WCS, or calibrated variance.

recommended_temporal_specific_labels.label: TEMPORAL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE
recommended_temporal_specific_labels.definition: No independent repeat epoch exists in local archive for the requested celestial footprint.

recommended_temporal_specific_labels.label: TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
recommended_temporal_specific_labels.definition: Repeat epoch exists in remote archive manifests but Level-2 FITS assets are not retrieved.

demo_readiness_verdict.selected_verdict: LIMITED TEMPORAL CAPABILITY — SAFE FALLBACK VERIFIED
demo_readiness_verdict.justification: Differencing algorithms and astrometric reprojection are fully functional and capable of demonstrating registration and dipole rejection on intra-visit dithers. However, zero local multi-epoch data exists, so secular transient claims must be completely barred via safe fallback labeling.
safe_demo_scope: Demonstrate sub-pixel WCS reprojection and fatal mask dilation on Pointing 0010 / 0003 dithers.
Demonstrate variance-weighted significance mapping and 5x5 stamp dipole vetoing.
For candidate search or multi-epoch timeline queries, display TEMPORAL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE badge.
Explicitly label any intra-visit differencing as 'Astrometric Registration Verification' rather than 'Secular Transient Search'.
